title: Close the billing account
intro: Closing erases this organization's billing data in CTech Billing: credentials, customers, subscriptions, invoices, webhooks. The documents cannot be recovered afterwards; keeping them is the taxpayer's duty, so export what you need first. Your CTech account and the other products are not affected.
steps: When you confirm by e-mail the account becomes read-only right away.
You can cancel through the e-mail links for 7 days.
After that the data is erased and this cannot be undone.
